name: smart-bus-tracking-system
description: Root scripts only. Each part (backend, apps/*) has its own package.json and node_modules.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix apps/admin-dashboard install && npm --prefix apps/driver-app install && npm --prefix apps/passenger-app install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix apps/admin-dashboard test -- --watchAll=false
